searchText: I just want to throw out some good vibes and say thank you all for the work you put into this space! hi! how often are the dev merge calls in here? There are two fortnightly calls: ACD and Consensus-layer call that are happening on different weeks. These two calls is where the dev merge discussion is currently happening. Look into issues here for more detail https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/ FYI I am proposing a change to the beacon-APIs that prevents attestations, aggregate attestations and sync committee contributions from being returned from the BN API if they refer to an optimistic block. I suspect other implementations might already be doing this: https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/216 fyi That's best discussed with the Prysm team and giving them debug logs. We've seen something similar in a partition test. i have not checked the balance. As no validator could not finalise epoch, so everyone would suffer inactivity penalties. thanks - fixed we're planning the next Merge Community call for June 3 - 1400 UTC (10 EST). it would be great to have at least one contributor for each client (EL + CL) + a few researchers be present to field questions. DM me your email address if you'd like to join, and i can add you to the calendar invite https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/532

FYI I am proposing a change to the beacon-APIs that prevents attestations, aggregate attestations and sync committee contributions from being returned from the BN API if they refer to an optimistic block. I suspect other implementations might already be doing this:

https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/216
